case_cluster: Resample100 case columns; keep all three seeds and both arms in each column together.
per_seed: paired case bootstrap95 plus individual-model Wilson95
fixed_three_seed_average: paired case-bootstrap95 and97.5 intervals;97.5 for two-suite claim decision

claim_rule: Record positive conditional mean improvement for a suite only if its97.5 case-cluster interval lower bound is strictly above0; report all seed results and any regressions regardless.
